step1_join_coverage.note: Matched = records with a parseable predict_* blob and a non-empty raw_response. Unmatched rows are NOT silently dropped -- every one is accounted for above by reason.

step2_3_detection_and_correction_tables.ground_truth_definition: An item's ground truth 'error present' = the SAME model's baseline (no-critique) solve on that problem_id was wrong. checksum_detectable/invisible labels are recovered by bit-for-bit RNG reproduction of the experiment's error characterization, verified exactly against the experiment's own reported fraction.

supersedes_prior_llm_judge_figure.note: The deterministic checker is adopted as the new primary checksum-arithmetic-error figure per the artifact plan: it recomputes a ground-truth arithmetic fact (digit root is a closed-form function of the integer) with zero LLM calls, removing the same-model circularity of claude-haiku-4.5 judging its own traces.

hypothesis_claims_verdict_summary.claim: 18.75pp accuracy gap, checksum vs free-form critique (claude-haiku-4.5, checksum-detectable subset)
hypothesis_claims_verdict_summary.detail: Detectable-subset n=64 per condition (from the only available experiment, which used a different problem generator than art_UafZp2AqR5at). Original accuracy-based effect-size figure (98/97.5% vs 80.5%, n=32) is REPLACED here by proper precision/recall/F1 with Wilson CIs on the SAME small n -- both figures inherit the same n<20-per-cell underpowering the artifact plan flagged; treat pp-gap point estimates as directional, not confirmed at this n.

hypothesis_claims_verdict_summary.claim: 9.375pp accuracy gap, checksum vs placebo critique (claude-haiku-4.5, checksum-detectable subset)
hypothesis_claims_verdict_summary.detail: Same underpowered detectable-subset n=64 applies; see above.

hypothesis_claims_verdict_summary.claim: 100% (self-checksum) vs 93.75% (oracle-supplied correction) on the detectable subset -- oracle-ablation claim that detection, not correction, is the bottleneck
hypothesis_claims_verdict_summary.detail: Re-derived via STEP3's correction-accuracy-given-TP metric (see correction_accuracy_table): the prior comparison mixed overall accuracy (which folds in detection AND correction) with an oracle fix-rate. The properly isolated comparison is n-limited (see correction_accuracy_table per model) and does not by itself establish detection-vs-correction as the bottleneck at this sample size; the direction (self-checksum >= oracle-informed fix rate) is preserved but not confirmed as a detection-is-not-the-bottleneck claim.

hypothesis_claims_verdict_summary.claim: ~15% checksum self-computation-error rate (prior same-model LLM-judge audit)
hypothesis_claims_verdict_summary.detail: Deterministic, LLM-free mod-9 checker over 312 traces with parseable digit-root claims gives a new primary error rate of 0.09615384615384616 (vs prior same-model-judge figure of 0.1538 on 80 traces). Cohen's kappa between the deterministic checker and a freshly re-run LLM judge on the reproduced sample = -0.12000000000000041. This new figure supersedes the prior same-model-judge estimate per the artifact direction.
